How could Mo Wentu (Page 22) be like this? Isn't this the pair of shoes worn by the deceased when he attended the funeral? How could they appear here? It's incredible. Li Bing is now sitting on the bed staring at the pair of shoes under the bed. "In the future, Beach will find a husband who is excellent in all aspects, and he can't be too far away from us." Wei Junze said quietly. He was lying on a bed, and the lights in the room were not turned on. Open, the light moonlight poured down from the window, covering his quilt. With such a treasure for self-defense, unless Ye Wuji set up a large formation to isolate the entire battlefield, it would be impossible to leave Ye Qingxue behind. "Are you so happy to see your cousin?" Hearing Qu Xiaoyan's words, He Xianming also asked in a happy mood, "Okay, cousin is the best." Qu Xiaoyan hugged He Xianming's neck happily and lowered her head to rub He Xianming's chest. , covering up the sudden feeling of disgust in his eyes. With the news of the manager's death, the news that many cooperations on the road were broken continued. During this time of making plans, the Rose Knights and the Reincarnation Department of the Blood Alliance were not idle, and they carried out quite detailed "care" for those who had secretly made trouble for the Blood Alliance. The power that can be more terrifying than the Holy King can only be sacred, and apart from the sacred, it is impossible to be so silent with others. He sneaked in. "But, how does that figure look like Qin Heng?" Xue Shuang looked at the figure facing the dark thunder, and inexplicably thought of the young man in Tianhai. As for the ancient animal fruit, even the phantom beast species Vegapunk may not be able to see it. "Damn it!" Yun Wuyou roared angrily, his face was ashen, as a person with a strong sense of justice, he felt unfair for these souls born in hell.
